summary: Frontend regression sweep for IslandHop pre-deploy. Verified admin approvals category defaults, new Live Shops tab, businesses approve/reject buttons, orphan-driver Repair wrench flow, Forgot Password page, Reset Password (invalid + happy path). 8/8 primary requirements pass.

integration_issues.issue: reset-success testid not detected after clicking reset-submit-btn (DOM likely already advanced to next state or auto-redirects); however backend password change verified: POST /api/auth/login with NewPass5678! returned 200. Consider adding a persistent success view before any redirect for testability.

Toast success message not captured in DOM after successful mutation. Mutation itself confirmed (driver appeared in pending list, count 46 -> 47). Toast probably dismissed too quickly or renders outside standard toast containers.

issues: No data-active or aria-pressed on approvals-status-pending / approvals-status-all buttons; active state only distinguishable via className (bg-gold-gradient). Recommend adding aria-pressed for accessibility and easier testability.

data-testid=approvals-search-input is not consistently present on every category tab (missing on drivers tab per DOM query). Placeholder-driven inputs render ("Search driver applications...") but lack the shared testid, making cross-tab search automation brittle.

action_items: Add data-testid="approvals-search-input" consistently across ALL 6 category tabs (currently visible only on some, e.g., users tab shown but not queryable on drivers tab in same session).
Add aria-pressed / data-active attributes to approvals-status-pending / approvals-status-all so tests don't rely on Tailwind class inspection.
Ensure ResetPassword renders a persistent success state (data-testid=reset-success) before any auto-redirect on submit.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend hero page hitting external assets returning 403 (visible in console). Non-blocking but noisy.
Admin auth JWT stored in localStorage.token (per spec). Fine for now, but consider migrating to httpOnly cookie for XSS protection.
Reset happy path relies on dev_token in response body — ensure this is disabled outside preview envs.
